name: naturum Fjärås Bräcka - Äskhults by
description: naturum Fjärås Bräcka to Äskhults by. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
utilities: Naturum Fjärås Bräcka och Café Bräckan (food)
waterSources: Dricksvatten utanför Naturum Fjärås Bräcka: Green water post by Café Bräckan outdoor seating/water-play area.
notes: Hallandsleden official page/API/GPX says 9.8 km; Naturkartan displays 10.0 km; one 2025 blog casually says 9 km; TopoGPS out-and-back gives 19.1 km round trip.

Official GPX and API geo_json match current N2 endpoints and 9.779 km. API line.geometry has 849 coordinates, runs about 15.75 km from near Stensjön to Äskhult, and appears to be an older/broader line.
Naturkartan endpoints match official N2 but middle alignment diverges by roughly 0.53-0.57 km and computed length is shorter.
OSM relation is named Hallandsleden Etappen Stensjön - Äskhult and totals about 16-17 km, not current Naturum Fjärås Bräcka - Äskhults by at 9.8 km.
Stensjön shelter/toilet are included in some N2 facility/source text but lie about 5.3-5.5 km north of the current N2 official GPX start.
Hallandsleden lists a fireplace at the Äskhult shelter, while Länsstyrelsen's Äskhult rules prohibit fires generally.

facilities.name: Naturum Fjärås Bräcka och Café Bräckan
facilities.description: Start-area visitor centre with exhibition, café/shop, information, nearby toilets and water, and views over Lygnern/Kattegatt/Kungsbackafjorden. Café/shop/exhibition opening hours vary; water point is separate and more reliable.

facilities.name: Dricksvatten utanför Naturum Fjärås Bräcka
facilities.description: Green water post by Café Bräckan outdoor seating/water-play area. Official text says open year-round.

facilities.name: Toalett Fjärås Bräcka
facilities.description: WC at Fjärås Bräcka parking by Naturum. Official text says open year-round.

facilities.name: Fjärås Bräcka south/Naturum parking
facilities.description: Large gravel parking for Naturum/Fjärås Bräcka and section start access.

facilities.name: Kolerakyrkogården vid Fjärås bräcka
facilities.description: Cholera cemetery from the 1834 epidemic near the route after Naturum.

facilities.name: Li gravfält
facilities.description: Large Iron Age grave field with more than 100 standing stones; Hallandsleden passes close by.

facilities.name: Frodestenen
facilities.description: Largest stone at Li gravfält, a short spur from the route.

facilities.name: Svalhögen
facilities.description: Gravel hill, ancient-grave setting and viewpoint on Fjärås Bräcka.

facilities.name: Limmahögarna - stormansgravar vid landsvägen
facilities.description: Bronze Age burial mounds by the old road/ridge corridor.

facilities.name: Den gamla Förlandavägen och Via Regia
facilities.description: Historic road/corridor along the ridge, used as a travel route for a long period.

facilities.name: Västra Skogs skvaltkvarn
facilities.description: Maintained old water mill at Skärbäck; official section text and reports describe it as a worthwhile short detour.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Äskhult
facilities.description: Section-end shelter/campsite with wind shelter for 4-5 people and fireplace. Toilet and drinking water are at the Äskhults by parking and are seasonal/conditional. Äskhult reserve rules prohibit fires generally, while Hallandsleden lists a fireplace at the shelter. Verify whether the designated shelter fireplace is exempt before public fire-use copy.

facilities.name: Toalett Äskhults by
facilities.description: WC at Äskhults by parking near the section end and shelter; water bottle filling is possible when water is on. Hallandsleden place text says the toilet is closed in winter and water is available when turned on; shelter place text says water/toilet at parking are open April-September.

facilities.name: Äskhults by
facilities.description: Historic village and culture-reserve visitor site with seasonal café/guided visits; landscape/buildings reflect older farm environments. Do not model café/service as always available; opening hours are seasonal/currentness-dependent.

facilities.name: Hållplats Bräckaskolan - Fjärås Bräcka
facilities.description: Bus stop access point for Fjärås Bräcka and the N2 start walk.
